reason: I re-ran the analysis and the null holds. Adding the 2020 patent rate, the other pre-period covariates, region, listing status and segment gives coefficients of about -0.2 to -0.3 (p of about 0.24-0.40), and the checks for heterogeneity and nonlinearity find nothing. The CI is tight, roughly ±0.5 patents on an outcome with an SD of 10.9. The raw positive association (+1.6) is explained by firm size. The analyst omitted the lagged outcome and trimmed on the outcome, but neither changes the conclusion. 'No detectable effect' would be a more careful wording than 'no effect'.
